audience.text: Python developers building 3D content pipelines, especially in 3D printing, CAD visualization, and model conversion workflows.

capabilities.text: Imports OBJ, STL, glTF/GLB, COLLADA, and 3MF files using Scene.open() with automatic format detection or explicit FileFormat specification.
capabilities.title: Import multiple 3D formats

capabilities.text: Exports scenes to OBJ, STL, glTF/GLB, and 3MF using Scene.save() with format-specific SaveOptions for fine-grained control.
capabilities.title: Export to common 3D formats

capabilities.text: Build meshes from control points and polygons, convert primitives to meshes, and triangulate arbitrary polygon data.
capabilities.title: Construct and manipulate meshes

capabilities.text: Assign LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, or PbrMaterial to nodes and set diffuse, specular, albedo, metallic, and roughness properties.
capabilities.title: Assign and configure materials

capabilities.text: Create hierarchical scene graphs using Node.create_child_node(), manage transforms per node, and attach entities and materials.
capabilities.title: Build and traverse scene graphs

capabilities.text: Create Box, Sphere, Cylinder, and other primitives programmatically and convert them to editable meshes via to_mesh().
capabilities.title: Generate parameterized primitives

capabilities.text: Construct keyframe animations using AnimationClip, AnimationNode, and KeyframeSequence, and store skeletal bind-pose data with Pose.
capabilities.title: Support keyframe animation

limitations.text: FBX import is experimental and FBX export is not implemented; FbxExporter.save() raises NotImplementedError.
COLLADA export is not reachable through Scene.save() due to exporter lookup order issues.
Scene.render() and the entire aspose.threed.render module raise NotImplementedError; image rendering is unsupported.
Texture construction raises NotImplementedError; image-backed textures cannot be created.
Mesh boolean operations (union, difference, intersect) raise NotImplementedError.
NURBS curve evaluation and surface-to-mesh conversion raise NotImplementedError.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic creation, modification, and export of 3D scenes using a pure-Python API without requiring external SDKs or native binaries.
Supports common 3D file formats (OBJ, STL, glTF/GLB, COLLADA, 3MF) for import and export, facilitating interoperability across tools and workflows.
Provides parameterized primitives (Box, Sphere, Cylinder, etc.) and mesh construction tools to generate geometry programmatically.

product_summary.text: Aspose.3D FOSS for Python is a pure-Python, MIT-licensed library for loading, constructing, and exporting 3D scenes without native dependencies.

uncertainties: The exact set of formats supported beyond those explicitly listed in format:input and format:output facts is unclear; some formats may be registered but not functional.
Whether the experimental FBX importer works reliably with real-world FBX files is uncertain given the lack of integration tests.
The behavior of Scene.save() when passed a stream without a filename and without explicit FileFormat detection is not fully documented beyond examples.

workflows.name: Scene import and inspection
workflows.text: Load a 3D scene from a file using Scene.open() and inspect its geometry, nodes, and materials.

workflows.name: Scene construction and export
workflows.text: Build a scene from primitives or raw mesh data, assign materials, and export to formats like glTF, STL, or 3MF.

workflows.name: Mesh manipulation
workflows.text: Construct meshes from control points, create polygons, and triangulate arbitrary polygon data using PolygonModifier.triangulate().

workflows.name: Material assignment
workflows.text: Assign LambertMaterial, PhongMaterial, or PbrMaterial to nodes and configure diffuse, specular, albedo, metallic, and roughness properties.

workflows.name: Scene graph navigation
workflows.text: Traverse and modify the scene graph using Node.create_child_node(), Node.add_entity(), and Node.child_nodes.

workflows.name: Animation and skeletal pose setup
workflows.text: Build keyframe animations and store skeletal bind-pose data using AnimationClip, AnimationNode, KeyframeSequence, and Pose.
